scope: Reverse-Bessel differential, Padé, and fixed-length Wronskian admission for the overlap-normalized beta high-singleton valuation problem

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The scaled reverse-Bessel jets satisfy Z_(i,j+1)=Z_(i,j)+Z_(i-1,j)-2j Z_(i-1,j-1), with Z_(i,0)=q_(N+i).
claims.evidence: report equations (2.1)-(2.3), obtained by exact differentiation
claims.scope_limit: the factor 2^j is a unit at the odd matching primes

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: Every fixed index window and every fixed jet reduce over Z[N] to the unimodular boundary pair (q_N,q_(N+1)).
claims.evidence: report Section 3 and exact forward/backward continuant recursions
claims.scope_limit: window and jet order are fixed independently of N

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: Every admissible fixed-size determinant has the homogeneous integral expansion sum C_k(N) q_N^k q_(N+1)^(s-k), with deg C_k <= s(d+L+J).
claims.evidence: report Section 4; multilinearity after the two-generator reduction
claims.scope_limit: coefficients are fixed rational polynomials after one fixed common denominator

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_NO_GO
claims.claim: Away from finitely many integer roots of the first nonzero C_k, a deep singleton gives v_p(D_N)=k v_p(q_N)+v_p(C_k(N)); k=0 is blind, while k>=1 is a formal q_N^k factor.
claims.evidence: report equations (4.5)-(4.6) and unique-minimum valuation argument
claims.scope_limit: not an impossibility theorem for growing-length auxiliaries, new functions, or every use of the determinant

claims.label: PROVED_HEIGHT_METHOD_NO_GO
claims.claim: If the forced-branch determinant is a nonzero integer, its absolute value is at least q_N^k and therefore already has k N log N+O(N) lower height.
claims.evidence: formal divisibility and Item265's exact beta height asymptotic
claims.scope_limit: this rules out the ordinary fixed-determinant height shortcut, not all arithmetic uses of D_N

claims.label: PROVED_UNIT_BRANCH_BLINDNESS
claims.claim: The exponential Padé Wronskian specializes to P_N(1)Q_N'(1)=(-1)^N modulo q_N, so the argument derivative is a unit for every prime-power exponent.
claims.scope_limit: it proves simple argument roots, not a bound on their p-adic distance from 1

claims.label: PROVED_DEOVERLAP
claims.claim: If q_N^k divides D_N, then qbar_(m,N)^k divides D_N/gcd(D_N,D_m^k), where qbar=q_N/gcd(q_N,D_m).
claims.scope_limit: the forced beta factor cannot be booked again on top of the two-copy clearing reservoir

claims.label: EXACT_FINITE_ONLY
claims.claim: The portable checker replays reverse-Bessel, scaled-jet, two-generator, determinant-expansion, Padé-Wronskian, and overlap identities on bounded exact ranges.
claims.scope_limit: no exceptional-singleton or zero scan is performed

claims.label: OPEN_NOT_PROVED
claims.claim: No uniform v_p(q_N) log p=O(N) theorem, sufficient little-oh variant, or growing-length sub-main-height auxiliary is obtained.
claims.scope_limit: the missing input must use global seeded information or a uniform approximation measure for the canonical p-adic zeros

claims.label: PROVED_BOOKING_DECISION
claims.claim: The positive-linear capacity admission test fails; no new Route-1 rate or beta capacity reduction is booked.
claims.scope_limit: Route 1 and every conclusion about e+pi remain open
